reason: E2 states that severe plasticity processes like AFSD develop fine nanocrystalline structures with increased performance in various materials, supporting the grain refinement and property improvement premises. However, neither E1 nor E2 provides evidence on hot-cracking avoidance, interface cohesion, or performance specifically in high-entropy alloy systems, leaving several key premises unsupported.
premises: AFSD avoids melting and thus hot cracking
AFSD induces dynamic recrystallization and grain refinement
AFSD yields improved mechanical properties vs fusion welding
AFSD produces a refined, cohesive interface
AFSD benefits apply to high-entropy alloy systems
